requirements.quote:
PING frames are formatted as shown in Figure 24, which shows that
   PING frames have no content.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a PING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the PING frame with no frame content after its type field.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include or accept content fields in a PING frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded frame can be inspected to verify that no content follows the type field, and a parser can be tested with a PING frame containing extra content.

requirements.condition: When encoding or identifying a PING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the integer-encoded frame type value 0x01.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not identify a frame with a type value other than 0x01 as a PING frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame type field and its decoded integer value can be directly inspected.

requirements.quote:
The receiver of a PING frame simply needs to acknowledge the packet
   containing this frame.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint receives a packet containing a PING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Acknowledge the packet that contains the PING frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can deliver a packet containing a PING frame and observe whether the receiver generates acknowledgment behavior for that packet.
